description: Land Acquisition - Imbulana & Anguruwella, Ruwanwella D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lots A-H) with their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land matters, specifically the declaration that certain lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
